description: The BYD Qin L DM-i is a plug-in hybrid mid-size sedan manufactured by BYD Auto since 2024. It is part of BYD's Dynasty Series lineup and has a sister model known as the Seal 06 DM-i. It is positioned between the smaller Qin Plus DM-i and the larger Han DM-i It is part of the BYD Qin series.
